object_description: compact square building volume with a sloping tent roof
design_condition: The volume is placed along the eastern site edge and set into the slope, extending the existing pavilion arrangement while forming a new playground center and preserving the broader open-space structure.

positive.statement: The setting and volumetrics integrate pleasantly into the existing open-space structure.
The compact, clear floor plan offers varied spatial qualities and good orientation.
The simple structure can flexibly adapt to educational and organizational developments.
The construction with prefabricated elements is coherent and economical.

negative.statement: The public path creates an unfavorable overlap with school operations and weakens the clarity of the main access route.
The intervention in the protected existing buildings is excessive in two places.
The exterior design remains vague and imprecise.
The high basement proportion and extensive intervention burden the gray-energy balance.
Night cooling will be ineffective despite the openable windows.
